style_definition.primary_identity: Loosely drawn, actor-first mid-2010s Japanese fantasy sitcom TV animation: charmingly unstable character drawings, snappy facial and body acting, occasionally awkward but intentional posing, few thin lines, flat two-tone cels, and clean painted background planes in an earthy palette. Every person and animal is redrawn on the series' character model, also a real, well-known person: large eyes about one fifth of the head height with a heavy dark upper lid, a soft rounded face with a small chin, and hair in big pointed clumps; never a realistic face traced with outlines. Only half about cuteness: calm drawings are plain and appealing, reactions are unflattering and grotesquely funny. Not a polished generic anime portrait, a digital character painting, a glossy game illustration, or a cute mascot conversion.
style_definition.aesthetic: Playful, irreverent, scruffy, earthy, warm, adventurous, deadpan, emotionally volatile
influences: Expressive children's television character acting adapted to older comedic storytelling
Loose hand-drawn animation and controlled off-model reaction drawings
Traditional animation cels with restrained digital compositing
style_definition.adaptability: Apply to people, animals, objects, present-day interiors, landscapes, existing illustrations and fantasy scenes without forcing a fantasy setting or replacing recognizable identity.
style_definition.core_principle: Sell an individual acting beat through silhouette, timing-implied gesture, facial construction and unequal features; a quiet deadpan drawing is as characteristic as a wild off-model reaction. Production-frame economy outranks surface beauty. Recreate from drawing fundamentals: the style is the combined animation production language and the acting, never just a costume, a fantasy setting, big anime eyes, or saturated coloring.

rendering.medium: 2D Japanese television-animation frame: thin colored linework and flat two-tone cels on the characters, over a hand-painted background with visible brush texture
rendering.technique: Construct as rough-clean animation key art rather than a finished illustration: broad uneven model-sheet shapes, sparse tapered contour strokes, flat fill, one optional hard shadow shape. Strip away redundant furry strokes, little shadow facets and glossy eye rendering.
rendering.detail_resolution: Very low on character cels: broad contiguous silhouette, few fur or hair clumps, almost no interior marks. Background brush texture may remain sparse and localized.
rendering.source_translation: Reconstruct as a genuine captured animation drawing, not a photographic anime filter, smooth vector mascot, elaborate key visual, or polished mobile-game character illustration.
rendering.surface_finish: Flat, clean broadcast-era animated frame with small handmade variation
rendering.detail_distribution: Put the detail into designed features, never into surface texture: graphic eyes, the acting of face and body, hands, key props, crisp cast shadows and designed light. Fur, hair, skin, cloth, wood and stone are flat color masses with smooth edges and very few marks. A frame looks drawn by a TV animator, never like a painted portrait of a real animal or person. A converted image has less surface detail than its source, never more, and more designed detail in the eyes and the acting
rendering.redesign_rule: Rebuild the subject as an animation character model of itself, never a trace of the source: the pose, the markings, the colors and the identity stay recognizable, but the proportions move toward animation (a slightly larger, rounder head, a simpler rounded body, simpler and shorter limbs) and every contour is redrawn as a smooth animation line. A result that could be laid over the source photo line by line is wrong

composition.structure: Character-performance-centered TV anime composition; economical staging that makes gestures and expression immediately understandable
composition.hierarchy: Facial acting and gesture first; overall silhouette and costume identity second; environment third
composition.camera: Keep the source shot scale and camera angle when the source already reads as one of the shot types; otherwise choose the shot type that serves the moment. Use extreme close-ups, abrupt low angles or comic group arrangements only when the scene intent supports them.
composition.perspective: Simple coherent perspective with intentional exaggeration for physical comedy
composition.shot_language: An ordinary held TV frame should look like it came directly from a motion sequence: slightly awkward camera-aware posture, non-perfect balance and one specific readable acting beat. Do not add reaction iconography or change a neutral action into an excited one.
composition.silhouette: Asymmetrical, mobile, slightly angular or rounded according to acting; never uniformly doll-like
composition.depth: Foreground characters graphically separated from the painted background; behind a close-up, the background softens a little, like painted depth, never photographic bokeh
composition.aspect_ratio: Preserve source aspect ratio and meaningful crop
composition.group_interaction: Maintain asymmetrical differences in each character's expression; prevent everyone from wearing the same generic anime smile
rules: Read the emotion at thumbnail size
Allow faces and bodies to momentarily go off-model without losing identity
Keep ordinary compositions simpler than dramatic reaction shots
Preserve pose, subject count, environment and key spatial relations
Repeated pictures of the same subject vary eye alignment, mouth placement and pose; never the same centered, poster-perfect front view
Preserve the source affect; add exclamation glyphs, sparkles or other reaction symbols only when the source or the scene shows a reaction
Use asymmetrical body weight and imperfect limb overlaps while keeping the source anatomy
shot_types: Wide establishing shot: small figures in a large painted landscape or town, drawn at the distant-figure level
Medium two-shot or ensemble shot with overlapping figures and different reactions
Reaction close-up with the face cropped by the frame edge
Extreme close-up of one eye or one mouth for a dramatic or comic beat
Foreground framing: a hat brim, a shoulder or a doorway crosses the frame edge in the foreground

framing.default_shape: Full-bleed animation scene without added decorative frame

outer_background.type: Actual scene environment, rendered as animation background art

linework.primary_style: Thin, nearly uniform hand-drawn contours with a loose, slightly jagged shape: the weight stays even, the path wobbles a little and turns at small angles. Not uniformly smooth vector outlines, not tapered calligraphic ink lines
linework.outline_color: A darker, more saturated shade of the color that the line outlines

external_contours.weight: Thin: approximately 0.25-0.35 % of the image height (3 px at 1080 px), up to 0.45 % in close-ups
external_contours.appearance: Nearly even weight; slightly loose, hand-drawn path with occasional small angular jogs
external_contours.continuity: Mostly continuous; near-black only for the upper eyelid mass

internal_contours.weight: Fine to medium, typically 45-70% of external contour weight
internal_contours.density: Very low; omit lines that merely describe texture rather than anatomy or expression.
application: Distinctive tattoos and accessories simplified as line symbols
internal_contours.budget: 3-6 strand strokes per hair mass, 1-2 fold lines per cloth panel

rules: Never use identical mechanical curves for both eyes and cheeks
Let eyebrow, jawline and mouth contours distort independently
Line weight must change naturally, with slight irregular animation-like shape variation
Keep internal line count lower than modern high-end anime illustrations
Prefer broad anime hair wedges over finely separated strands
Do not outline every fur tuft or stripe independently; use irregular flat color islands instead
Faces need irregular contour rhythm and variable spacing, not mirrored lids or a centered sticker-like expression
Line color follows the fill hue; black lines only in the eyelid mass
linework.silhouette_rule: The outer contour is smooth and continuous and built from simple volumes (a rounded head, a bean or pear body, tube limbs). Fur, hair and feathers break the contour with small notches at two to four chosen places only, for example the cheeks, the chest and the tail tip; never serrated or zigzag edges along the whole outline or along markings

color_system.identity: Earthy, medium-saturation broadcast cels: warm browns, cream, terracotta and ochre, with sky blue and muted foliage greens; clear local colors in flat islands, never pastel and never high-key
color_system.saturation: Medium: the whole picture averages approximately 0.34-0.42 saturation
color_system.contrast: Strong separation between characters and setting, modest shading contrast within skin
color_system.temperature: Warm skin and warm interiors, balanced by sky blue and blue-grey distance and shadow
color_system.palette_rule: These are reference swatches, not mandatory recoloring. Retain identity-defining hue, hair, clothing and environment colors from source; convert them into clear separated animation paint areas.
color_system.iris_color_system: People: a flat, hard-edged iris; the upper approximately 60 % dark, a bright saturated crescent at the bottom, a small bright vertical pupil mark; one round semi-transparent highlight and one or two tiny white chips. The richness comes from the saturated color next to the dark part, never from gradients. Animals: see subject_design.animals.
color_system.shadow_policy: Use distinct local shadow colors rather than black or muddy neutral overlays
color_system.background_policy: Clean painted planes with smooth fills and soft gradients for depth; pale blue distance; the colors of the scene's own light
avoid: An unmotivated tint over the whole scene (a grade without a sunset, a night, or magic in the scene)
A peach or purple ambience in daylight
A soft nostalgic green-and-cream pastoral palette
Cold grey-steel or desaturated gritty palette
Neon or colored club and stage light over the whole frame
color_system.value: Mid to mid-low: the whole picture averages approximately 0.44-0.55 brightness
color_system.source_color_grade: The color grade of the source photo or render (a purple or neon night, orange-teal, sepia, a heavy tint) is not identity. Keep the subjects' own identity colors, and relight the scene with the palette and light of this style; a night scene takes the style's cool blue night grade

lighting.type: Unshowy animation production light with the scene's own local colors: everyday daylight or warm interior light; golden or sunset light only when the time of the scene calls for it; night as a cool blue grade of the whole frame, never neon or colored stage light; the characters keep readable local colors at night
lighting.shadow_style: Zero or one strongly designed flat cel shadow island per main body section; no feathering, no ambient occlusion gradients
lighting.highlight_style: Tiny single eye glint only if motivated; avoid fur and skin gloss
lighting.contrast: Mostly local-value contrast, with deep dark contour accents and restrained shadow coverage
lighting.effects: Glow, light rays and particles only for magic or for a motivated outdoor light; characters stay flat cels inside every effect
lighting.light_design: TV light design: a crisp cast shadow under the subject, a warm light pool or sun patch on the ground or wall, and a soft glow in the distance of the background; the subject itself stays flat cels
lighting.weather_and_reflections: Rain as a few thin straight streaks; wet ground as a few soft vertical color blocks under lights; never photographic reflections or dense rain texture
lighting.time_of_day_grade: A motivated grade over the whole frame, characters included: sunset as a warm orange-to-magenta grade, night as a cool blue-teal grade, dim interiors as a warm ochre-green dusk; daylight stays clear with neutral colors. The grade comes from the time of day of the scene, never from the source photo

shading.method: Two-value cels by default: base fill plus one irregular hard-edge shadow, sometimes base only. No soft shading on the subject.
shading.skin: Flat base and one hard warm shadow; no skin highlights; restrained hatched blush only for emotion
shading.hair: Large color masses with one hard shadow; long hair may fade softly toward a warmer or darker tip, the only soft gradient on a figure
shading.metal: One clear bright facet and one dark facet
shading.ambient_occlusion: Extremely limited; omit ambient occlusion on most forms
shading.soft_gradients: Avoid gradients on characters; on backgrounds only subtle intentional paint transition for depth, never full-frame color overlay.
shading.priority: Silhouette and acting > clean shape rhythm > believable cel production > material fidelity
shading.face: A small hard shadow patch under the nose of people
shading.shadow_design: One shadow shape for each color area, with a smooth designed edge that follows the form; a white or light area gets one cool light-grey shadow shape, never several grey patches. Crisp graphic highlight shapes only on wet, glossy or metal surfaces and in the eyes

subject_design.overall_style: Not idealized cute-anime design: variable imperfect proportions, irregular eye placements, slightly ungainly poses, strongly character-specific expressions, and abrupt changes between attractive calm drawings and unattractive comic extremes.

anatomy.normal: Recognizable youthful or adult proportions appropriate to original subject, slightly simplified rather than fashion-illustration elongated
anatomy.comedic: Squash cheek masses, shift chin, widen jaw or shrink neck for expression; hands and arms can briefly stretch for acting
anatomy.age_and_physique: Preserve distinct age and build differences; avoid making all characters interchangeable pretty young adults
anatomy.hands: Broad simplified finger groupings with acting-focused gestures

face.head: Head shape can be subtly lopsided, with cheeks and muzzle/jaw changing contour for a particular attitude rather than a perfectly symmetric oval
face.eyes_normal: People: medium size, never dominant; a solid dark upper lid wedge with one or two notches, a faint or absent lower lid, a flat iris (see color_system.iris_color_system), uneven spacing and tilt, often half-lidded
face.eyes_comedic: Animate the whites, lids and pupils as one acting system: sudden dots, mismatched eyes, unfocused stares, squashed eyes or almost-closed lids. Make the deformation specific to the situation, not permanently cute.
face.brows: Brows and eyelids carry the response with off-center angles; on animals adapt using brow ridges and ear rotations, no pasted human eyebrows
face.nose: People: a short hook line with a small hard shadow patch under it; in comedy, a filled shadow shape; never a modeled nose with nostrils and side shading
face.mouth_normal: A tiny crooked stroke, slightly misplaced wedge or simple open shape; do not center every mouth perfectly or attach a permanent cheerful smile
face.mouth_comedic: A wobbly, asymmetrical dark-maroon cavern or bean shape with a flat salmon tongue and a white tooth block, when a clearly energetic reaction is called for; never a neat emoji smile with a tongue
face.cheeks: Blush as 4-7 thin parallel diagonal pink strokes, only for emotion
face.tears_and_sweat: Outline-only drops, used as performance punctuation
face.off_model_rule: Dramatic deformation only when justified by source expression; in calm frames show mild handcrafted unevenness rather than compulsory surprise.
face.eye_scale: People's eyes are clearly larger than real eyes: each approximately one fifth of the head height, set wide and low, with a heavy dark upper lid wedge and a short outer lash flick
face.lips: One short line for the mouth, with at most one small flat tone for lipstick; no lip shading, lip gloss or modeled lips
face.eyes_closed: Happy or laughing eyes as two curved arcs, sleeping eyes as soft lines, pain or effort as squeezed zigzag lids
face.calm_face: A calm or neutral face is welcome and is an acting choice of its own: a deadpan stare drawn on the series model, with half-lidded, slightly uneven eyes, high thin brows, and a tiny flat mouth. It is never the source face traced with anime outlines and never a generic pleasant portrait expression

expression_library: Flat uninterested half-lidded stare with tiny mouth
Smug side-eye with one lifted brow
Frozen shock with vacant white eyes and pinpoint pupils
Catastrophic scream with mouth occupying a third to half of face
Embarrassed pleading with huge isolated teardrops
Irritated puffed cheeks and sharply angled brows
Disgusted squashed face with grimacing mouth
Sudden sinister grin with tiny pupils
Joyful overconfident laugh with eyes squeezed shut
Gloom: blank eyes and a few vertical lines over the upper face; on a person also a light transparent blue shade there, on an animal drooped ears instead of any tint
Intense or magical stare: a close, flat bright eye; a person's iris may glow with a soft bloom only in the eye, an animal's eye stays a flat colored oval with a narrowed pupil
Crying wail: a huge open mouth and streams of outline tears
subject_design.expression_contrast: Normal-to-extreme ratio is dynamic: neutral shots use attractive simple model, reaction shots use very large deviations; do not make every frame hysterical or every character permanently chibi.

hair.construction: Big irregular clumps with flat pointed tips, asymmetrical spikes and few internal line breaks
hair.motion: Slight directional bounce and stray tufts, never photo-fine hair strands

subject_design.animals: Keep the species recognizable, rebuilt as an animation model: a slightly larger, rounder head, a smooth bean or pear body and simple tube legs, coat geometry and body mass, simplified into flat fills with one hard shadow and an outline in a darker shade of the fur; no fur texture. Eyes are animal eyes, never the human iris: flat colored ovals with a simple slit or dot pupil and at most one small chip highlight, narrower and less glossy in calm shots, never enlarged into round glass marbles. Keep the natural muzzle, eye setting and ears; act with the eyelids, the ears and the muzzle, never with pasted human brows, a human smile, a fang grin or blush. In comic shots, eyelids, muzzle and cheeks squash or stretch decisively (closed dashes, or huge white eyes with a tiny dot iris) while the animal stays its species. Coat stripes and spots become a few broad flat color bands with smooth edges, approximately five to eight on the body, never dozens of serrated strips; a white area keeps a smooth outline. Whiskers are none or two to three short strokes per side; the nose is one small simple shape without nostrils; the inner ear is one flat color shape without fur tufts. The eyes are designed graphic shapes: a clearly outlined almond or oval with a heavy dark upper lid line, a flat iris in two tones (a darker upper band and a lighter lower part), a slit or dot pupil and one crisp white highlight shape. Black fur reads as a dusky warm mauve-brown (fill #684951, shadow #4A3A44, line #54373C).
subject_design.costumes: Keep source silhouettes and colors; folds 1-2 per panel; leather, latex and metal gloss as one or two crisp highlight streaks, never reflections; no material texture
avoid: Huge sparkling eyes with many highlights
Animal eyes enlarged into round glass marbles
Reaction symbols around a calm subject
Serrated fur edges along the outline or the markings
Several grey shadow patches in white fur
subject_design.people: Keep age, build and identity; a person, also a real and well-known one, is recognized by hair, clothing, build, colors and expression, while the face itself follows the series model; plain, sleepy or awkward faces are welcome; distinct body types; slightly simplified proportions, never fashion-elongated legs or child-like proportions for adults. Anatomy is simplified into animation forms: muscles, fat and skin folds are suggested by one or two lines and the one shadow shape, never modeled; hair is a few big flat clumps with 3-6 lines each, and stubble or a shaved side is one flat tone
subject_design.objects_and_props: Readable silhouettes with few lines, flat fills and one hard shadow; metal with one bright and one dark facet; no material microtexture
subject_design.identity_items: Keep every identity item of the source (tattoos, piercings, jewelry, chains, buckles, prints, logos, patterns, glasses), but draw each one as a simple animation symbol: a tattoo as a flat motif of a few lines in one tone; a stack of piercings as two or three small dots or rings; a chain as a few links or a dotted line; buckles and straps as flat shapes; a fabric pattern (floral, damask, plaid) as a few large repeated motifs or flat stripes; a print or logo as its simplified graphic silhouette. Text from the source appears only when it is essential to identity, as a few simplified letter shapes

simplification_levels.normal_model: The subject's own design with the rules above
simplification_levels.gag_model: For a cute, small or comic moment, the same subject can drop to a strongly simplified gag model: an animal as a rounded blob or bean body with stubby legs, a round head, small triangle ears, dash or dot eyes or flat oval eyes without a pupil, a tiny triangle mouth, no whiskers, and its markings as one or two flat shapes; a person with dot eyes, a simple open mouth and a smaller body
simplification_levels.distant_figure: A figure that is small in the frame is drawn with very few lines: dot or dash eyes, no nose, flat hair masses, no accessory detail
simplification_levels.rule: Choose the level for the moment and the size in the frame; never render a small or comic subject with more detail than its level

subject_design.animals_small: Pets and other small animals lean toward the series' rounded animal model: a big round head of approximately half the body mass, a compact rounded body, short simple legs, small triangle ears with one flat inner-ear shape, large simple flat eyes (a flat colored oval with a heavy dark outline, a slit or dot pupil or none, one crisp highlight), a tiny nose and mouth, none to two short whiskers per side, and the markings as a few flat shapes with smooth edges. The animal stays recognizable by its colors, markings and pose
subject_design.people_model: People are rebuilt on the series' character model: a head slightly larger than real (approximately one sixth to one seventh of the body height), a soft rounded face with wide cheeks and a small chin, large eyes set wide and low (each eye approximately one fifth of the head height) with a heavy dark upper lid wedge and a short lash flick at the outer corner, eyebrows as thin short strokes that sit high, a hook nose with a shadow patch, a small mouth, a short neck, simplified hands with grouped fingers, and hair as big pointed clumps with a few strand flicks at the ends. Glasses are thin simple lines in front of eyes that stay large and fully drawn. Adults keep their age and build; faces stay plain and expressive rather than glamorous

botanical_design.importance: Only where the source contains foliage
botanical_design.style: Broad painted foliage masses with a few readable anime contour leaves; no ornamental requirement

background_design.style: Background-department painted TV scenery made of clean planes: smooth flat or softly graded fills, crisp dark lines at stone and plank joints, cracks, window frames and edges, and only a few local brush patches (a grass tuft, a grime spot, a cloud rim). Simplified architecture: few windows, distant buildings as flat silhouettes with a few lit windows, simple perspective, weaker edges than the cels
background_design.source_fidelity: Keep a recognizable source location and its landmarks; never replace an everyday room with a fantasy village. A plain floor or a blurred photo background becomes a full TV background of that kind of place around the subject: a few readable props, structure drawn with crisp line cracks and plank or stone joints, and designed light. Never copy the source photo's color cast, blur, light leaks or bokeh. Every surface of the photo, also the ground and the landscape, is repainted as TV background planes, never kept as photo texture
background_design.architecture: Credible simplified geometry, large textured planes and selected architectural identifiers
background_design.nature: Trees and grass as a few layered flat masses with a few brushed tufts at their edges; clouds as soft shapes with a few hard rims; distant hills as flat pale blue planes; nature is bright, clean, and graphic, like a TV background, never lush leaf-by-leaf feature-film foliage
background_design.interiors: Simple coherent furniture shapes, grouped shelves and decor, warm brown atmosphere; floors and walls as large planes with a few broken brush patches, never dozens of repeated grain strokes
background_design.surface_texture: Almost no texture: no all-over brush strokes, stipple, noise, streaks or painterly grain on walls, floors, roads or skies; a few local brush patches only
background_design.background_edges: Soft broad paint transitions and fewer dark outlines than foreground
background_design.scene_complexity: Medium: a staged place with a few readable props and clear structure, never an empty floor or wall behind the subject, and never cluttered enough to hide the acting
avoid: An empty floor or wall as the whole background
The source photo's color cast or bokeh
An unmotivated tinted gradient over the whole scene
Lush, densely leaf-painted foliage and soft nostalgic skies of a gentle feature film
Gritty dark ruins or cold grey metal rooms as the whole atmosphere
background_design.clutter_rule: A dense source scene is reduced, not copied: keep the three to six largest props that identify the place (for example a sofa, a shelf, an instrument, a lamp), drawn as simple shapes; shelves of books or objects become rows of flat color blocks; posters, tapestries and screens become flat simple shapes with one motif; small clutter is left out. The picture reads as a TV set dressed for one scene, never a catalogue of objects
background_design.staging_rule: The subject never sits on a bare floor or blank ground alone: even a close or high-angle shot shows part of the place around it (a wall base, a piece of furniture, a doorway, a step, a mat, a basket or a bowl), drawn as simple shapes in the scene's light

ornamental_language.importance: Very low unless source contains decorations
ornamental_language.identity: Existing costume and setting motifs represented through simple graphic cels
ornamental_language.rule: Do not add halos, filigree, decorative borders, sparkles, or magical sigils merely to make the frame visually rich

texture.character_surface: Pure matte flat paint; coat patterns must be shape-based, not texture-based
texture.background_surface: Clean planes with smooth fills; a few local brush patches only; no noise or grain
rules: Texture must never replace drawn shape language
texture.finish: Clean digital broadcast color: no film grain, no sepia or faded print tone, no vintage paper or VHS overlay, no halftone

mandatory_features: Clearly hand-drawn 2D animation frame, not promotional illustration
Intentionally flexible and mildly off-model facial construction
Wide spectrum from flat deadpan to grotesquely exaggerated reactions
Oversized irregular open mouth shapes when emotions demand them
Expressive asymmetrical eyebrows and uneven eye proportions
Flat base colors and at most one main cel-shadow layer
Distinct character body types and preserved recognizable designs
Humor and personality prioritized above beauty
Face design can be stubbornly plain, sleepy or awkward; comedy comes from acting contrast, not permanent cuteness
No auto-generated reaction punctuation or cheerful fang expressions
No overall orange/purple cinematic grading, even when keeping sunset light
For animals preserve believable narrow eye proportions and anatomy rather than inflated kawaii eyes
Interrupt vector smoothness with a few purposeful irregular contour directions
Thin, nearly uniform outlines in a darker shade of each fill, with very few interior lines
People's eyes: dark upper lid wedge, flat iris with a dark top and a bright saturated bottom crescent, one round highlight and tiny chips
A small shadow patch under the nose of people
Hand-painted background with visible restrained brushwork and pale blue distance
Earthy medium-saturation palette of warm browns, cream, terracotta and sky blue
optional_features: Simple speedline background in intense reaction
Gag model: a strongly simplified rounded version of the subject for a cute or comic beat
A gag cut-in: a small inset panel with a simple shape and a bold color border around a reacting face
Gloom lines over the upper face, with a light blue shade only on a person
Foreground framing by a hat brim, a shoulder or a doorway
explicitly_not_the_style: Generic polished 2020s gacha anime
Hyper-detailed fantasy illustration
Shoujo glitter eyes
3D cel-shaded game still
Flawless facial symmetry
Photoreal anime conversion
Highly painterly line-free rendering
Every character cute all the time
Excessive glossy hair and skin
Thick-lined western mascot illustration
Chibi-only redesign
Golden hour illustrated pet portrait
Soft orange-violet gradient over the entire scene
Clean repeated symmetrical animal face in each variation
Automatic exclamation marks and excited mouth
Cute glossy animal sticker with oversized shiny eyes
Thick near-black outlines with bright primary colors and child proportions
Huge sparkling multi-highlight eyes with a pink and lavender palette and sparkle backgrounds
Dark indigo palette with hard graphic shadow blocks, rim light and a tense, technical mood
Pastel, desaturated, glossy mobile-game finish
Polished anime-style illustration that keeps every source detail and only adds outlines
Retro 1980s-1990s cel look with film grain, dense textured shading and heavy prop detail
Fashion-elongated proportions and realistic modeled anatomy
A photo traced line by line and filled with flat colors
A painterly or impressionist background behind flat characters
A vintage film or print look: grain, sepia tone, faded colors over the whole picture
A gentle pastoral feature-film look: lush, densely painted foliage and skies, soft nostalgic light, calm wonder, and round simple faces with small eyes
Gritty dark ruins or cold grey metal interiors as the atmosphere of the whole picture
A generic anime filter: the source face and proportions traced with outlines, with no acting choice, neither deadpan nor reaction
quality_checks: Would this pass as a frame of a mid-2010s Japanese fantasy-comedy TV episode instead of an AI-generated character poster?
Are the outlines thin, nearly even, and colored a darker shade of each fill?
Is every figure surface exactly a base and one hard shadow, with no gloss or soft shading?
Are brows, mouth and face shape expressive and plausibly off-model rather than perfectly pretty?
Does an animal keep its species face and flat animal eyes, without a human iris or an oversized cute gaze?
Does a calm subject stay calm, without an arbitrary happy mouth, blush or reaction glyphs?
Is the background hand-painted with restrained brushwork, without a tinted wash over the whole picture?
Is the palette earthy and medium-saturated, not pastel, not high-key, not neon?
Have source identity and scene layout survived?
Is the detail in the eyes, the acting, the props and the light, and are fur, hair and surfaces flat masses?
Is the outline smooth, with fur notches at only a few places?
Is there a staged background with props and designed light, not only the floor of the photo?
Is every tattoo, pattern, piercing, chain and logo a simple drawn symbol, not a rendered copy?
Are people's eyes larger than real eyes, with a heavy lid wedge, and are lips and nose simple marks?
Is the source color grade replaced by the style's own palette and light?
Does the detail level fit the moment and the size in the frame (normal, gag, or distant figure)?
Is a whole-frame grade motivated by the time of day or by magic, and absent in daylight?
Could the subject be laid over the source photo line by line? It must not: the proportions are an animation model
Are the background surfaces clean planes with crisp joint lines, without all-over brush texture?
Does a small animal have the rounded animal model (big round head, compact body, large simple flat eyes)?
Is a dense source room reduced to a few large readable props?
Does the subject stand in a place, not on a bare floor alone?
Do people have the series model: rounded face, small chin, large wide-set eyes with a lid wedge, big hair clumps, simplified hands?

source_adaptation.principle: Use source content as truth and fully replace the rendering with loose expressive fantasy-comedy television animation design.
source_adaptation.subject_independence: Apply the same fantasy-comedy television-animation language to photographs, existing anime, illustrations, people, animals, objects, present-day interiors, landscapes and fantasy scenes, without forcing a fantasy setting or replacing recognizable identity.

detail_budget.primary_subject: Keep identity-defining shapes, markings and accessories; render with a few flat color areas, one cel-shadow layer and organic animation contours.
detail_budget.face: Few lines: brow wedges, upper lids, simple 2-3-color irises, a small nose mark and a short mouth line; facial acting carries the detail.
detail_budget.hair_and_fur: Big irregular clumps with 3-6 strand strokes per mass; fur patterns as flat color shapes; no individual strands
detail_budget.clothing: Keep source silhouettes, jewelry, tattoos, labels and defining accessories; 1-3 fold shapes per section and spare cel accents.
detail_budget.background: Readable painted planes with soft broad paint transitions and fewer outlines than the foreground.
detail_budget.ornament: Only decorations that exist in the source, as simple graphic cels.

complex_source_handling: Reduce folds to 1-3 shapes per section
Reduce skin to a flat base color and one shadow
Reduce environments to readable painted planes
Reduce decorative text to a few legible symbols
Suppress photographic detail and reconstruct head, hands, torso, hair and costume as convincing drawn animation shapes
Overwrite glossy, highly detailed or elegant render qualities of existing anime: loosen faces, flatten colors, simplify hair
source_adaptation.complexity_rule: The more complex the source, the more decisively secondary detail is grouped into flat cels; the result stays a sparse-to-moderate television-animation frame whatever the source density.

source_adaptation.neutral_source_rule: Neutral is allowed to stay neutral, even bored or visually awkward. Imply animation through slightly uneven lids, small face placement differences and weight asymmetry. Do not add a grin, blush, reaction marks or a head-on cute pose.
source_adaptation.comic_source_rule: If source implies emotion or action, push reaction deformation decisively; prioritize genuine acting over posing for a beauty illustration.
source_adaptation.animal_rule: Preserve the original coat pattern, real species proportions, posture, head tilt and expression.
